_what: Measurement log, not a single response. Issue #173: what a show's own counters do when its watched episodes are deleted, and when a person un-watches it.
_how: Throwaway PMS 1.43.5.11029-6bf8af3f0 (plexinc/pms-docker), unclaimed, read and written as the local admin. One Personal Media TV library (agent tv.plex.agents.none), four shows of four 10-second episodes. Writes were /:/scrobble, /:/unscrobble and file deletion followed by a scan and emptyTrash. Each state was read from /library/metadata/{show}, /library/sections/1/all?type=2 with each filter, and /library/onDeck. The container was deleted afterwards. Recorded 2026-10-30.

states.action: play episodes 1 and 2, then delete both files, scan, empty trash
states.note: The #173 state, Continue Watching included. Re-adding one of the deleted files did not bring its watched state back (a fresh item under this agent).

states.action: the deleted-episodes show above, then 'Mark as unwatched' on the SERIES
states.note: A series un-watch clears the show's counters, so the show leaves both halves of the read. On Deck keeps a stale entry.

states.action: play episodes 1 and 2, then 'Mark as unwatched' on the SERIES
play episodes 1 and 2, then 'Mark as unwatched' on each EPISODE
states.note: Unmarking episodes one by one leaves the show's counters behind, so the show still reads as played. The way to make a show count as unstarted again is the series-level un-watch.

states.action: 'Mark as watched' on the SERIES, nothing played
states.note: The #108 shape: marks set episode counts and no show counters.

production_read_only_2026_10_30.server: PMS 1.43.x, one show library of 5,012 shows
